conventions.identity: Bind each prime unit to explicit dictionary definition IDs; reuse existing IDs where the definition already exists. Never identify by spelling or vector equality.
conventions.unknown_cells: Retain null and admissible domains. Explicit absence requires a warrant. Do not zero-fill prime vectors.

negative_volition.proposal: WANT=-1 for the explicitly identified DONT_WANT unit; WANT=0 remains absence.
negative_volition.alternative: A structured NOT scope over WANT; distinct geometry.

this.proposal: Use existing sentence-level deictic/reference structure; no additional coordinate in this build.
this.limitation: This leaves the standalone word-scale signature incomplete.

some_time.proposal: WHEN=1 plus a duration component whose relative level stays unknown until anchored.
some_time.limitation: WHEN alone cannot distinguish duration from time reference; do not invent a LONG_TIME sign.

conventions.number: Signed ordinal metadata on each explicitly named nonzero semantic component; preserve component sign and presence.

intensity_baseline.proposal: Use primitives_v2 ordinal hierarchy as construction baseline and explicitly migrate disagreeing modifier_hierarchy representations.

conventions.evaluation_scope: Separate own-word evaluation from evaluations nested in explications; retain the latter as structured evidence.
conventions.promotion: These proposed relations remain approved=false. Admission requires an explicit scoped justification and independent anchor checks; frequency alone cannot approve them.

rule_rationales.I/SOMEONE and YOU/SOMEONE: Person reference retains its distinct deictic coordinate plus person category.
rule_rationales.BODY/SOMETHING: Body-denoting nouns are independently denoting objects; this does not project a participant body into an action.
rule_rationales.ONE/QUANTITY and TWO/QUANTITY: Cardinality is quantity-bearing; do not infer a relative magnitude from this type implication.
rule_rationales.MOVE/HAPPEN, DO/HAPPEN, CAUSE/HAPPEN: Proposed event-category closure for actual lexical event components; does not infer an agent.
rule_rationales.GOOD/BIG and BIG/GOOD: Proposed conditional separation of pure evaluators and size descriptors from F067. Explicit joint descriptions are local exceptions.
rule_rationales.temporal/WHEN: A temporal subtype retains temporal content without losing its signed subtype.
rule_rationales.spatial/WHERE: A literal spatial subtype retains spatial content; metaphorical definitions can be local exceptions.
